text.p: Roche Holding AG reiterated its forecast of another good result with further profit increases in 1997.

But Roche said the size of profit growth would depend largely on new products being brought to market, and said launching products for the general practioner market would have short-term consequences for its product growth.
Chairman Fritz Gerber, in the copy of a speech released before its annual shareholder meeting, said the Roche Group was well positioned in all areas of operation.
"Barring unforeseen events -- the usual, but necessary, rider -- we anticipate another good result, with a further increase in profits in 1997," Gerber said.
Gerber said the size of that profit increase would depend largely on which new products it is able to launch this year.

"One must bear in mind that the introduction of newly-approved products will require the investment of significant sums in further expanding our position in the GP (general practioneer) market," he said.
"This will naturally have short-term consequences for profit growth," he said without elaborating.
The group already made similar forecasts at its annual news briefing in April. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
